summaries.en: Park Soon-kwan, CEO of Arisell, who was indicted in connection with the Arisell fire disaster that killed 23 people, had his 4-year prison sentence confirmed by the Supreme Court.
summaries.zh: 与23人死亡的Arisell火灾惨案相关的Arisell公司代表朴顺官，被大法院最终判处有期徒刑4年。

items.title: [속보] 이 대통령 "관행·절차 얽매이지 말고 주택공급 전격전 펼치길"

summaries.ko: 이 대통령은 관행과 절차에 얽매이지 말고 주택 공급에 전격전을 펼치라고 주문했다.
summaries.en: President Lee urged to wage a blitzkrieg for housing supply without being constrained by existing customs and procedures.
summaries.zh: 李总统要求不要受惯例和程序的束缚，而是全力展开住房供应闪电战。
